project_type: XianFire Framework (Express.js + Handlebars) server with Sequelize ORM
build_system: Node.js with npm; nodemon for dev. Framework: XianFire with express-session, bcrypt, Sequelize. No build step needed.
test_framework: None currently defined; verification via manual application testing
build_command: npm start (production) or npm run xian (development with nodemon)
test_command: npm run xian (dev mode); manually verify features in browser at http://localhost:3000
verification_instructions: 1) npm run xian to start dev server, 2) Open http://localhost:3000, 3) Login with admin, 4) Navigate to Residents module, 5) Perform CRUD, search, filter, archive, export tests, 6) Verify audit logs record actions, 7) Test role-based access (Staff, Resident roles see subset), 8) Verify CSV export works
snapshot_or_generated_files: Resident ID is auto-generated server-side using pattern 'BSD-YYYY-NNNNN'. No snapshot files, but generated IDs must be unique. seed.js must be run once (npm run xian with setup.js call), or edit setup.js to include seedResidents()
environment_constraints: Database must be MySQL on localhost:3306, user=root, no password, database=SmartCivi. Sequelize uses alter:true in sync. Models auto-export from models/index.js. HBS partials auto-load from views/partials/*.xian on app start.
contribution_requirements: All new files follow existing patterns: models use Sequelize with tableName in lowercase, controllers export async functions, routes use isAuthenticated + middleware chain, views use .xian extension with Handlebars {{}} syntax and {{> partial}} includes. Existing HBS helpers: eq, dateFormat, substr, gt, lt, gte, lte, add, subtract, range, dateTimeFormat, actionColor. No CommonJS require(); ESM only.
key_patterns: Model pattern: DataTypes, sequelize.define(), timestamps:true, associations in models/index.js. Controller pattern: async functions, try-catch, User.findAll/findOne/create, render() or redirect(). Route pattern: express Router, middleware chaining (isAuthenticated, hasPermission). View pattern: {{> head}}, {{> sidebar}}, {{> topbar}}, {{> footer}} partials, Tailwind classes, flash messages, conditional {{#if}}, {{#each}}, {{#eq}}.
relevant_files: models/AuditLog.js - study model pattern for action tracking
models/index.js - update with new model imports and associations
routes/index.js - add new routes following pattern
views/users.xian - study table, search, filter, pagination pattern
views/dashboard.xian - study stats card pattern for resident counts
middleware/auditLog.js - use for resident activity tracking
models/seed.js - extend to seed barangays and residents
directory_structure: Root: models/, controllers/, routes/, middleware/, views/, public/, bin/, utils/. Models in models/ export Sequelize definitions. Controllers in controllers/ export async route handlers. Routes consolidated in routes/index.js. Views: *.xian files, partials in views/partials/. Middleware in middleware/. No new directories needed for RIMS; all fits existing structure.
